title: How Ed Sheeran’s Tour Turned Into a Clash Over Palestinians and Antisemitism
summary: Four supporting acts dropped out of Sheeran’s tour, citing the right to free speech after the rapper Macklemore was removed over pro-Palestinian comments he had made onstage.
